page.layout: One page of text, centred. Ornamental borders above and below (not text). Dedication block in the centre: title lines in roman and italic, ending with the initials "I. G. L." below. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.

main_text.head: VIRO AMPLISSIMO ORNA-TISSIMOQ. NOBILITATE, VIRTUTE, prudentia, & autoritate maximo; Doctrina & usu rerum eximio Heroi, D N. BERNHARDO BRANDT, REIPUBLICAE BASILIENSIS TRI-buno vigilantissimo, Gravitate suspiciendo, Patriæ Parenti meritissimo, Mecœnati & Studiorum Opt. Fautori summè honorando, Domino suo clementissimo, HASCE DISPUTATIONUM SVARUM INAUGURALES THESES POLITICAS, suæ in ipsum observantiæ, Synceri aut in Patriam amoris testimonio, Et ingenuæ de sese expectationis trophæo, AUCTOR ADDICTISSIMUS, SYMPA-triota vero devotissimus, Cum Laborum suorum commendatione officiosa, Exhibet, Offert, Confecrat

page.notes: Printed text is set in mixed type: large capitals for the names and titles, italic for the middle lines, small capitals for "Exhibet, Offert, Confecrat". The "u" in capitals such as VIRTVTE, REIPVBLICAE and SVARVM is a vowel and is written as U. "Mecœnati" is printed with the œ ligature. The "triota" after SYMPA- is printed in lowercase as it stands. No doubtful readings.
